sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/cedar-creek-state-park/lodging/camping-at-cedar-creek-state-park/ ('The campground offers 66 regular campsites and 10 group campsites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve online (WV State Parks booking site), by phone or at the campground office (a restored log cabin serves as check-in). Weekend (Friday and Saturday) reservations need both nights; one night Sunday-Thursday.

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/cedar-creek-state-park/lodging/camping-at-cedar-creek-state-park/ ('Campsites may be reserved anytime online, by phone, or at the campground office', 'Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday and Saturday) or one-night Sunday through Thursday', 'There is a 14-night maximum stay'), read 2026-10-21

note: If towing or driving a camper in, the park advises taking Route 5 through Glenville rather than Cedarville and Copen Road. --Claude
summary: Confirmed the inherited reservable/booking site/2-night weekend minimum/14-night max for Cedar Creek. Added 30-amp electric with water at the sites, 66 regular sites (+10 group). Fees left as recorded ($44.99, booking site 2026-10-12). Season stays the agency note ('open spring through fall', no dates). Not stated: sewer, max rig length, bathhouse/dump.
